news.title: Chip stocks rebound after their worst weekly selloff since 2008
news.text: US semiconductor and AI-networking names bounced in premarket trading Mon 19 Oct after the Philadelphia semiconductor index (SOX) fell 11.4% last week — its steepest weekly drop since March 2025 — on AI-spending and rate concerns. Intel rose ~4.2% premarket after a J.P. Morgan upgrade to Neutral; Nvidia, AMD and Micron also gained. The iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) climbed ~3.6% premarket after falling almost 12% last week.
